card.title: Galaxy A12 No Backlight

claims.statement: On Galaxy A12, rule out the display and the main FPC (often broken on A-series) before diagnosing the board backlight circuit.
The backlight output coil leaking 'oil' usually indicates a short on the backlight output line; a blown capacitor in the circuit is the most common fault.
claims.evidence: Coil leak and shorted cap shown in guide.

claims.statement: Shorted backlight lines frequently take out the backlight IC as well; repair kits with caps, controller, coil and diode are available.

procedure: Inspect the main FPC; replace if damaged.
Diode-mode the backlight circuit components (CPU side) for shorts.
Replace shorted capacitor and leaking coil; replace backlight IC/diode if needed.
Use low heat near the CPU.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Excess heat near the backlight circuit can damage the nearby CPU.
card.caveats: Expected diode values are in an image on the source page, not transcribed. Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
